cases.input: Exact package, manifest, executable, operation, schema-valid JSON, allowed root, concurrency one.
cases.expected: One canonical schema-valid stdout result, no sensitive stderr, exit 0, exact redacted evidence.

cases.input: Wrong contract digest or operation/input schema.
cases.expected: No operation side effect; structured rejection; exit 2.

cases.input: Filesystem path outside allowed root, network request, or secret request under the first proof.
cases.expected: Fail closed before access; exit 2; redacted evidence names only denied access class.

cases.input: Timeout, cancellation race, second concurrent call, missing/reused invalid idempotency key.
cases.expected: Lower timeout enforced; cancellation propagated; excess concurrency refused; no automatic retry; each outcome classified deterministically.

cases.input: Stable MCP initialize, tools/list, and tools/call for the exact reviewed tool.
cases.expected: Exactly one discoverable tool with exact schemas and structured result; no resource, prompt, sampling, or extra tool surface.

cases.input: Missing/tampered adapter, executable, manifest, schema, or incompatible package.
cases.expected: Adapter advertises no tool and returns deterministic startup/invocation failure without running the proof.

cases.input: Existing server id, existing tool name, changed owned table, missing/mismatched lock, untrusted/out-of-scope project.
cases.expected: No TOML or lock mutation; exact collision/ownership diagnostic; unrelated configuration byte-identical.

cases.input: Absent collision plus exact package/contract/executable/adapter bytes and explicit human register.
cases.expected: One project-scoped server table and exact ownership lock; status verifies; no process auto-started by registration.

cases.input: Session A ends completely; session B has semantic intent only and no inherited conversation/path/syntax/process/environment/manual-shell state.
cases.expected: Codex discovers and invokes solely from persisted registration; evidence binds exact session/process/provider/package/adapter/lock/result facts.

cases.input: Explicit compatible update, then explicit exact removal, then isolated session C.
cases.expected: Old bytes rejected after update; unrelated TOML preserved; only owned table/lock removed; session C cannot discover the tool.

cases.input: Consumer project reference, ProgramKit source/file include, assembly hint path, build-output coupling, or uncontrolled first-party NuGet source.
cases.expected: Construction/conformance fails before acceptance; no cold-session proof claim.

cases.input: Self-registration, self-permission, auto-start, development-capability invocation, AI/provider call, or tool/model loop.
cases.expected: Static/runtime conformance fails and the review set cannot close.
